evidence: decorative_mascot: Data waves and cheers beside the numbers (hook@0.3 to seg0:end), stands under the ruler (seg1:mid), perches on the seesaw and on the circle (seg2:end, seg3:mid), then stands pointing at the grid through the whole closing (seg4:start to payoff@-0.4). weakest_scene.visible_evidence: From hook@0.3 to seg0:end the frame is a two-row scoreboard: '900' and '27.6K' in big type, a mascot waving beside each, and a dotted rail on the right. The only change is Data sliding from left to right across the 27.6K row.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The speed comparison was drawn as a labelled stat table. Nothing shows speed as motion, so the hook's 'you've never moved this fast' promise has no picture behind it.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the speed into motion. Race a jet against the ISS along the same arc over a curved Earth horizon: in the time the jet crawls one short tick, the ISS laps across the whole frame about 30 times. A distance counter ticks up under each one so the 30x gap is visible before any number is read. Data should run a stopwatch or try to chase the station, not stand beside a number.
